Chapter 6889: Return

Chapter 6889: Return

“The fault is with Dark Realm, not with us.” Immortal Devourer also activated his aura to stop Controller.

“Immortal Devourer, you are impatient for wanting to seize authority despite being so young.” Controller said, intensifying his aura.

“It has nothing to do with age. It’s a matter of deserting during war.” Fire Immortal said.

“That’s for us to decide.” Devouring Lord roared.

“Dark Realm has lost the right to judge.” Fire Immortal disagreed.

“It appears we must judge you today then.” Devouring Lord barked back.

“Devouring Alliance will remove Dark Realm from its ranks!” Immortal Devourer shouted.

“Immortal Devourer, know your place instead of blustering and risking death.” Controller said.

“Does Dark Realm have the power to kill me? And killing me doesn’t win the crowd over anyway.” Immortal Devourer said.

“So be it, let’s get this started.” God Messenger said.

“I fear not death for the sake of the alliance!” Immortal Devourer shouted and activated his cauldron.

“I will deliver judgment!” God Messenger raised his heavy sword.

As the two golden immortals prepared to fight, a voice interrupted them: “Look at this pathetic display.”

Invisible hands separated the two easily. The crowd then noticed a light with the hue of wheat pulsing in the darkness.

It was the center of Stygian, capable of creating worlds. The immortals recognized the majestic life force emanating from there. They also understood the significance of the wheat.

“An internal struggle right before the actual fight, how shameful.” The wheat opened, revealing a figure shrouded in a robe made from thin golden strands. His physical body could be seen pulsing with a colorful light.

He didn’t wear shoes so his feet radiated a primordial light. His hair flowed freely and gracefully. He was born as an immortal, destined for greatness.

“Your Highness!” The three messengers bowed.

“His Highness Guangmai?” Others have heard of this legend before.

“Who is he?” A younger overlord didn’t know.

“Progenitor Mang’s direct disciple.” An immortal whispered.

“!” The overlords became emotional since Guangmai was a primordial immortal.

After Mang’s death, Zhao Dachui was the one who revitalized the alliance. He spread its influence outside of Stygian, commanding immortals to sneak into other worlds.

This expansion made the alliance even stronger than during Mang’s generation. Future generations considered Zhao Dachui to be Mang’s successor or direct disciple.

This was not true since Guangmai was the actual disciple. Some believed Guangmai had reached the primordial stage before Zhao Dachui.

Instead of taking the reins, he disappeared later. Only a few immortals knew his heart was not in the alliance, but to search for something.

Today, his appearance surprised everyone. He glanced at the world’s heart and Li Qiye in a daze.

“Your Highness, your return is most welcome news. You can lead us now.” Immortal Devourer bowed.

Guangmai finally looked at them and said: “I am not interested in authority.”

As a primordial immortal, he instilled great pressure into the crowd despite not actively doing so.

The three messengers heaved a sigh of relief since this man was a unique entity, perhaps supreme after Mang.

They recalled how he was the chosen leader after Mang’s death. However, Zhao Dachui was so talented and somehow reached the shore. No one knew how he did it.

His brilliance made people forget about Guangmai. Since he was no longer around, Guangmai was the highest existence in the alliance.
